evidence.lifecycle_v1_parent_shape: Qualified Lifecycle v1 fixtures use keyed object collections for governing_briefs, canon_manifests, story_bibles, book_plans, manuscripts, research_evidence_links, author_decisions, integration_proposals and export_releases.
evidence.lifecycle_v1_lookup_behavior: Lifecycle v1 evidenceObject/author-decision lookup requires keyed object collections and computes parent identity with digestParentState over the complete projected object.
evidence.current_parent_shape: Qualified Version/Rollback and Author Decision Queue fixtures/runtime use array collections and an explicit state_digest sealed by computing sha256 over the state with state_digest excluded.
evidence.version_rollback_receipt_requirement: Version/Rollback recordAuthorizedParentSuccessor requires authority receipt pre/post parent digests to equal the current sealed parent state's state_digest values.
evidence.facade_check: lifecycle-transition-engine-runtime.js contains no current-parent array/digest compatibility adapter.

failure_modes_if_unrepaired: A current array export_releases collection cannot be resolved as lifecycle evidence by Lifecycle v1 evidenceObject().
A current array author_decisions collection cannot satisfy Lifecycle v1 author-decision gates without projection.
Lifecycle v1 receipt parent digests are not guaranteed to equal sealed current parent state_digest identities expected by Version/Rollback.
Directly modifying Lifecycle v1 would invalidate its exact-SHA qualification and silently broaden the proven subject.
Letting Export Freeze compensate internally would create an unqualified hidden lifecycle bridge and duplicate lifecycle authority.

strategy: Keep BOOK-SYSTEM-LIFECYCLE-TRANSITION-ENGINE-001 source and gate semantics unchanged.
Project the current sealed-array parent into the exact keyed collection shape required by Lifecycle v1 for evaluation only.
Translate evidence refs, author decision refs and integration proposal refs by stable IDs without inventing or dropping records.
Bind the v1 projected lifecycle ledger to the projected-parent digest only inside the delegated v1 call.
After a v1 COMMITTED project transition, apply only the proven lifecycle status/state-version delta to the original current parent, then reseal using the current parent state_digest algorithm.
Emit a compatibility receipt whose canonical pre/post parent digests are current sealed state_digest identities while preserving the underlying v1 receipt and its digest as evidence.
Translate the lifecycle ledger back so its external bound_parent_state_version/digest match the current sealed parent.
Reject any projected v1 result that changes parent collections, active pointers, book identity or any parent field other than the lifecycle-authorized status/state-version delta.
Qualify the adapter on an exact SHA with predecessor Lifecycle v1 regression coverage plus current array/digest integration cases.

research_gate.reason: This is a strict compatibility repair of already-qualified behavior with no new capability, policy, provider authority or lifecycle gate semantics; it falls under the research-before-implementation repair exception.

must_not: Modify or relabel Lifecycle v1 qualification in place.
Create new lifecycle transitions or gate types.
Let the adapter mutate manuscript, release, proposal or evidence collections.
Treat adapter PASS as transfer of Lifecycle v1 qualification to unrelated changed code.
pass_unlocks: Resume BOOK-SYSTEM-EXPORT-FREEZE-001 implementation using the qualified compatibility adapter for the separate lifecycle handoff.
